To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
REDCap has demonstrated a significant impact on research informatics support and has become an important resource for clinical and translational investigators.

(1) REDCap is an innovative workflow methodology and software tool for rapid development and implementation of electronic data capture systems for research; (2) REDCap is currently used by over 1000 research teams at over 200 institutions worldwide; and (3) REDCap is a collaborative project that is actively seeking new partners to expand the reach of the REDCap software and methodology.

REDCap is a novel metadata-driven workflow methodology and software application designed to facilitate rapid development and deployment (within days) of electronic data capture and management tools for clinical and translational studies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development, deployment, and assessment of a workflow methodology and software system to support the electronic capture of data for clinical and translational biomedical research.
developing a novel informatics methodology and software solution for supporting translational research.
the use of REDCap to support the development of informatics tools for translational research.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

REDCap is an effective and efficient workflow methodology and toolset that has been successfully deployed to provide informatics support for a large and growing number of clinical and translational science projects.

the REDCap methodology has been successfully applied to a growing number of translational research studies and has proven to be a useful tool for the support of research teams in the conduct of their work.
REDCap is a novel and effective workflow methodology and software toolset for supporting the capture and use study related metadata from research teams.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
REDCap has proven to be an extremely flexible, robust, and cost effective informatics solution for the support of clinical and translational science research projects.
REDCap is a flexible and robust solution for supporting the needs of translational researchers.
REDCap is a flexible, scalable, and sustainable solution for electronic data capture in translational research.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a flexible, metadata driven workflow methodology and supporting software toolset can be used to support the rapid development and deployment electronic data capture tools for clinical and translational studies.
a novel workflow methodology, combined with an open source software toolset, can be used to provide rapid development and deployment services to support translational research informatic activities.
a metadata-driven approach can be successfully applied to the development and deployment of a software solution that is both flexible and scalable.
